records.name: Clarimalt XD (Muntons)
records.reason: Quarantined: source specifies zero extract, but no reliable numeric extract specification was found. Do not use zero as unknown in recipe calculations.

evidence.factual_basis: Identifies this exact variant as a liquid malt extract intended for beverage colour/flavour adjustment. No yield or solids specification is published on the variant page.
Roasted Malt Extract sheet: refractometric solids 49.0–59.0%; colour 680–925 EBC at 10% w/v. Linked from manufacturer brewing URL whose slug is clarimalt-xd-liquid.

uncertainty: The linked brewing sheet may describe the current XD offering, but does not name the XD variant, and its colour test differs from the imported record. Refractometric solids is not directly a brewing gravity yield/fine-grind extract; no exact numeric replacement is supported. Do not average 49–59% into an invented 54% yield.
Water solubility is distinct from solids mass fraction and yeast fermentability.
records.restore_when: A reviewed numeric extract value is available; remove these explicit fingerprint exclusions after validation.
